q: Rokhlin's lemma states that for any aperiodic measure-preserving transformation T and ε > 0, there exists a measurable set F such that F, TF, …, T^{n-1}F are disjoint and:
exp: Rokhlin (Halmos-Rokhlin) lemma: for every aperiodic T and any n,ε, there exists F with F, TF, …, T^{n-1}F disjoint and μ(∪T^kF) > 1−ε. This is the key approximation lemma used in entropy theory and the proof of Ornstein's theorem.
